cases.question: How long does Meridian take to acknowledge a harassment report and complete an investigation?
cases.reference_answer: Meridian acknowledges reports within 2 working days and normally completes investigations within 30 calendar days.

cases.question: How many of my unused vacation days can I keep for next year?
cases.reference_answer: You can carry forward up to 10 unused days to the next year.
key_facts: Up to 10 unused days may be carried forward to the next year.

cases.question: What is the per diem for meals and incidentals in tier-1 cities?
cases.reference_answer: The per diem for meals and incidentals in tier-1 cities is USD 60 per day.

cases.question: What is the maximum value of a gift that Meridian Shipping shore-based employees may accept from suppliers, customers or agents?
cases.reference_answer: Meridian Shipping shore-based employees may not accept gifts worth more than USD 50 from suppliers, customers or agents.

cases.question: How long does it usually take for a line manager to approve a leave request?
cases.reference_answer: The line manager must approve the request within 3 working days.

cases.question: How far in advance must flights and hotels be booked?
cases.reference_answer: All flights and hotels must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure.

cases.question: If I lose my company laptop, who do I need to tell and how soon?
cases.reference_answer: You should let IT Security know within 24 hours of losing the device.

cases.question: How many paid sick days do I get each year?
cases.reference_answer: Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year.

cases.question: How long does it take to receive reimbursement after a claim is approved?
cases.reference_answer: Reimbursement is made within 10 working days of approval.

cases.question: What are the core working hours for Meridian Shipping shore-based employees?
cases.reference_answer: Core working hours are 09:30 to 17:30, Monday to Friday, with a one hour lunch break.

cases.question: How many days of paid bereavement leave are granted for the death of a spouse?
cases.reference_answer: Up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave are granted on the death of a spouse.

cases.question: Is travel time on weekends credited as leave or time off in lieu?
cases.reference_answer: No, travel time on weekends is not credited as leave or time off in lieu, unless the line manager approves compensatory time in writing.
key_facts: Travel time on weekends is not credited as leave or time off in lieu
unless the line manager approves compensatory time in writing

cases.question: If a business traveler loses a company laptop during a trip, what must they do and what travel booking rule applies to their flight?
cases.reference_answer: They must report the lost or stolen device to IT Security within 24 hours, and any flight they take must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure.
key_facts: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT Security within 24 hours.
All flights and hotels must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure.

cases.question: If an employee takes four consecutive sick days and receives a gift card from a supplier, what must they do according to the company policies?
cases.reference_answer: They must obtain a medical certificate for the sick leave and decline or report the gift card to Compliance, as it is a cash equivalent that may never be accepted.
key_facts: A medical certificate is required for any sick leave of 3 or more consecutive days.
Cash or cash equivalents, such as gift cards, may never be accepted regardless of value.

cases.question: If an employee needs to book a flight that departs in 5 days and also wants to work remotely from another country during that trip, what are the relevant travel and work policies they must follow?
cases.reference_answer: The employee must book the flight through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure, and they must obtain written approval from HR to work remotely from another country, which is limited to 20 days per year.
key_facts: All flights and hotels must be booked through the corporate travel desk at least 7 days before departure.
Working from another country requires written approval from HR and is limited to 20 days per year.

cases.question: If an employee reports harassment and also requests leave during a quarter‑end closing week, what are the timelines for the harassment report to be acknowledged and the leave request to be approved?
cases.reference_answer: The harassment report will be acknowledged within 2 working days and the investigation will normally be completed within 30 calendar days. The leave request will be approved by the line manager within 3 working days, but if it is not answered within that time it escalates to the Head of Department, and during a quarter‑end closing week it can only be granted with Head of Department approval.
key_facts: Reports are acknowledged within 2 working days
Leave requests are approved by the line manager within 3 working days

cases.question: What is the maximum number of days allowed for this situation?
cases.reference_answer: Either ask which is meant, or give both: up to 10 working days / up to 2 days per week

cases.question: How many days of leave can be taken for a personal emergency?
cases.reference_answer: Either ask which is meant, or give both: Leave requests are approved by the line manager within 3 working days. / Emergency leave of up to 3 days per year may be approved by a line manager for urgent personal matters such as a house fire or hospitalisation of a family member.
key_facts: Leave requests are approved by the line manager within 3 working days.
Emergency leave of up to 3 days per year may be approved by a line manager for urgent personal matters such as a house fire or hospitalisation of a family member.
